initial_pilot.qualification: Uncertified pre-final pilot sequence. The ee2ecd8a executable digest was observed before and during the sequence, but not independently captured at every launch; the final rebuild replaced it before collection ended. These runs are excluded from the final-binary comparison.

final_goal_status: M8–M10 COLMAP quality/speed/memory, scale ladder, restart and 100k I/O gates remain open

review.conclusion: Opt-in diagnostic only; 1k trajectory regression prevents default/mapper promotion.
interpretation: The physical damping metric changes, so the experiment does not isolate column scaling from damping.
Lower pixel objective does not establish better trajectory accuracy.
Maximum pixel/track errors are reported; prior input filtering thresholds are not silently redefined as a universal post-BA acceptance gate.
Large absolute physical residuals cannot be compared directly with scaled residuals without normalization; units alone can change norms.
Near-camera Schur cancellation was measured on the separate 10k main input, not proven as the cause of the 1k trajectory regression.
review.next_diagnostic_candidate: If needed after atlas measurements, compare one predetermined solve's normalized backward error against each policy's own physical equation, plus predicted/actual decrease and track-level step/error distribution; no GT-selected bounds or damping sweep.

primary_research.observed_main_schedule: 20 LM attempts alternate lambda=1e-4 solve hitting PCG512 cap and lambda=1e-3 accepted solve (237–272 PCG iterations). Rejected trace logs post-increase lambda, so all legacy-style LM log lambdas read 1e-3.

primary_sources.finding: Trust-region step quality compares actual and predicted nonlinear reduction; Ceres supports inexact iterative LM, not simply a fixed tiny residual tolerance.
LM strategy adjusts radius from step quality on acceptance, geometrically contracts it on rejection, and supplies q_tolerance while disabling r_tolerance.

primary_research.next: Bounded scalar diagnostics for actual solve lambda, normalized residual/backward error, undamped predicted vs actual reduction and step-quality ratio before choosing an adaptive/inexact LM policy. Keep default unchanged and avoid claiming this will cure 1k regression.
